subject: Pen test report and remediation closure - scope, ETAs & evidence request
messages:
From: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test report attached - ACME scope & initial closure asks

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for coordinating the pen test. Attached is the full report from our third-party assessor (ACME-PT-2026-06.pdf). The assessment surfaced a handful of findings we consider high priority for the current go/no-go gate:

- AUTH-01: Token revocation/rotation missing for long-lived service tokens (risk: privilege persistence)
- AUTH-02: Short-circuit auth path on legacy endpoint /v1/legacy-auth (risk: bypass)
- LOG-03: Insufficient audit logging for admin actions in the console (risk: lack of forensics)
- NET-04: Publicly exposed S3 bucket with backup artifacts (risk: data exposure)
- IAM-05: Over-permissive IAM role attached to batch job (risk: lateral movement)

For each finding we need: remediation owner, proposed mitigations, ETA for fix, and supporting evidence (configuration snapshots, test logs, or patched binaries). Ideally we get a remediation plan within five business days and evidence within two weeks for the critical items.

Please confirm scope agreed (attached report + the quick triage above) and share an expected timeline. Also let us know whether interim compensating controls will be applied (e.g., firewall rules, temporary key rotation) so we can accept mitigations in lieu of full code changes if necessary.

Attachment: ACME-PT-2026-06.pdf (report stub)

Best,
Tom Hughes
Lead Security Engineer, ACME Corp
security@acme.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report attached - ACME scope & initial closure asks

Tom / ACME team,

Appreciate you sending the report. We're aligned on the scope you listed. I've looped in Neha (security) for technical ownership and Aditya/Marissa for customer coordination and evidence delivery.

High-level plan and owners:
- AUTH-01 (token rotation) — Owner: Neha. Mitigation: enforce short TTL + automated rotation for service tokens; immediate manual rotation for identified tokens. Target: patch + rotation within 10 business days; evidence (rotation logs + config) by 2026-07-06.
- AUTH-02 (legacy endpoint) — Owner: Infra team (Neha to coordinate). Mitigation: disable legacy endpoint at edge and add auth hardening; rollback plan included. Target: disable within 3 business days; full code fix within 14 business days; evidence (access logs + config) by 2026-06-30.
- LOG-03 (admin audit logging) — Owner: Neha + SRE. Mitigation: enable structured audit events for admin console, preserve 90 days immutable logs. Target: enable within 7 business days; evidence (sample logs + retention policy) by 2026-07-02.
- NET-04 (S3 exposure) — Owner: Aditya / Infra. Mitigation: lock down bucket policy, rotate keys, and move backups behind VPC endpoint. Target: immediate lockdown (within 48 hours); confirmation + policy snapshot by 2026-06-24.
- IAM-05 (over-permissive role) — Owner: Neha. Mitigation: least-privilege rewrite, add role-boundary and temporary creds. Target: review complete within 5 business days; evidence (policy diff + access logs) by 2026-06-29.

I've attached a remediation workbook for tracking: remediation_workbook.xlsx (stub). Neha — can you confirm these owners and refine ETAs if needed? Also please add JIRA keys for each finding; we'll send ACME a consolidated evidence bundle when items for acceptance are ready.

Tom — if interim compensating controls are acceptable for AUTH-02 and NET-04 we'll note that in the evidence bundle (e.g., firewall block + disabled endpoint). Let us know the acceptance criteria for interim controls.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report attached - ACME scope & initial closure asks

Thanks Karthik / Tom — I reviewed the report and the plan. Confirming owners and tightening timelines where feasible. Below are the technical notes and proposed JIRA tracking for each finding:

- AUTH-01 (Token rotation) — JIRA: INFRA-542. Approach: enable short-lived service tokens (1h TTL) via our token broker, implement automated rotation job, and perform immediate manual revocation of affected tokens. ETA: rotation job deployed 2026-07-01; manual revocation completed 2026-06-26. Evidence: rotation logs, token broker config snapshot, audit entry.

- AUTH-02 (Legacy endpoint) — JIRA: APP-2181. Immediate action: place a deny rule at the edge (WAF) and route 403 for /v1/legacy-auth. Full code-level removal scheduled for 2026-07-08. Evidence: WAF rule screenshot and edge access logs (will include pre/post).

- LOG-03 (Admin logging) — JIRA: SRE-992. We'll release structured admin event logging and configure immutable log streaming to the audit S3 (with retention lock). ETA: 2026-07-02. Evidence: sample events, retention policy doc, CloudTrail/Audit export.

- NET-04 (S3 exposure) — JIRA: INFRA-559. Bucket policy updated and access revoked for public principals. Keys rotated and backups migrated behind a VPC endpoint. Completed: 2026-06-24. Evidence: policy diff + access logs + snapshot of bucket ACLs.

- IAM-05 (Over-permissive role) — JIRA: IAM-77. Role narrowed to least privilege; added a session boundary and enforced STS-based short sessions. ETA: policy push 2026-06-29. Evidence: policy diff, role usage logs.

I'll create a consolidated evidence bundle (pt_fix_digest.md) as each item becomes available and upload to the shared drive. For ACME acceptance, interim mitigations (WAF deny + bucket lockdown + manual key rotation) should be acceptable provided we deliver logs showing the block and a timeline for permanent fixes.

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-542 (token rotation ticket)

Attachment: pt_fix_digest.md (evidence digest stub)

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report attached - ACME scope & initial closure asks

Neha / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and clearly assigned owners. Interim mitigations (WAF deny for legacy endpoint and S3 lockdown + key rotation) are acceptable for initial acceptance if we receive the following by COB 2026-06-30:

- WAF deny rule evidence (screenshot + edge logs showing blocked requests)
- S3 policy snapshot + access logs showing revoked public access
- Confirmation of manual key rotation (list of rotated key IDs)

For the remaining items we expect the fuller evidence bundle (rotation logs, structured admin events, role policy diffs) by 2026-07-09. If you can get the interim artifacts to us earlier that helps our internal compliance review.

I'll circulate internally once we have the artifacts and confirm acceptance or request re-test.

Regards,
Tom
Lead Security Engineer, ACME Corp
